Name: Rose's Truffles Expanded
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
This mod makes truffles more profitable, It changes the truffle's label to forge and adds the "edible_mushroom" tag. Meaning truffles can now be placed in Preserves Jar and Dehydrator. I got bored of always turning truffles into oil, I made this mode to make truffles more interesting. I also increased the amount of energy the truffles gives when eaten.

Update (10/1/2025): I added config, you can change Truffle Prices, 400g - 600g

(For these wondering what texture i am using in the photos, i am using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18769]DSHi Shipping Items Retexture[/url] by birDfiSHi)

[b]Also, please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]
